facts.text: I am trying to create a budget for my monthly expenses.
I want to categorize my spending into needs and wants.
I have been having trouble with impulse buys lately.
I realized I didn't have enough money left for other essentials a week later after making a big purchase last month.
I am having trouble tracking my expenses, especially small purchases.
I want an app or spreadsheet template to help me get started tracking expenses.
I think I will try Mint.
I am worried about overspending on non-essential items.
I want tips to resist impulse buys.
I think the 30-day waiting period will be useful for me.
I think asking myself questions before making a purchase will be useful for me.
I want to try using cash for discretionary spending to make me more mindful of my purchases.
I think I will set reminders on my phone to wait 30 days before making a non-essential purchase.
I think I will create a note on my phone with questions to ask myself before buying something.
I will ask myself if an item aligns with my financial goals and values before buying.
I think tracking my progress and reflecting on my spending habits is a great idea.
I want to add a habit of reviewing my budget and expenses regularly, maybe weekly or bi-weekly.
I want to start a "want" list where I write down things I want to buy but don't necessarily need.
I want to reconsider purchasing items if I still want them after a certain period.
I want to avoid making impulse buys by making more intentional purchasing decisions.
